businessBoundary.businessMeaning: A payroll statutory operator reviews signed country-pack metadata and safely activates one approved insurance pack for one trusted legal-entity and pay-group population; payroll support then views immutable social-insurance outcomes with the exact activated policy version.

scopeResolution.g2VocabularyNormalization: TENANT is an implicit trusted partition, LEGAL_PAYROLL_ENTITY resolves to canonical LEGAL_ENTITY, and PAY_GROUP is required by accepted PEP-PAY-028 and the existing payroll authorization vocabulary.
scopeResolution.payPeriodExcluded: Pack activation is not a payroll-run population. Time applicability is represented by the approved half-open effective period and effectiveDate, not PAY_PERIOD.
scopeResolution.packIdResolution: The UUID packId identifies exactly one tenant-scoped installed-pack snapshot already bound by the Payroll owner to one legalEntityPublicId and one payGroupPublicId. The owner loads that record under RLS and uses its stored scope; no scope identifiers are accepted from the activation body.
scopeResolution.crossScopeBehavior: Unknown, cross-tenant or unauthorized packId returns opaque 404 before evidence, current revision or lifecycle state disclosure.

activationCommand.cas: If-Match must be one strong quoted canonical nonnegative activation revision and must equal the current installed-pack row version; stale or weak input returns 409 before activation mutation.
activationCommand.acceptedResponse: PayrollCommandReceipt.v1 with ACCEPTED or SUCCEEDED only after durable atomic state, receipt and audit-outbox persistence
forbidden: caller supplied tenant, legal-entity or pay-group authority
activation of a pack whose scope is absent or ambiguous
raw legal formulas, rates, executable code, secrets or document bytes in the request
a success response before durable commit

signedPackLifecycle.transitionRule: Every transition appends a new lifecycle or activation revision under compare-and-set. RETIRED is terminal. Any transition not listed above, including an unlisted skipped, reverse or same-state transition, returns 409 before persistence; listed SUSPENDED->ACTIVE is the only reactivation path.
activationPreconditions: the installed snapshot has one canonical payload digest and one supported signature algorithm and key identifier
signature verification succeeds against a separately admitted trusted key set
officialReferenceSet equals the stored approved reference evidence
goldenPackDigest equals the stored approved golden-pack evidence
statutoryApprovalReceiptId resolves to one approved receipt in the same tenant and exact pack scope
statutory approver differs from the recorded pack installer; the current activating subject is independently re-authorized and step-up verified but no unapproved third-actor inequality is invented
effectiveDate equals the snapshot lower bound and does not overlap another ever-activated winner for the same tenant, legal entity, pay group, jurisdiction and pack key
step-up, entitlement, action, population, field, purpose and audit decisions are current
immutabilityAfterActivation: tenant, legal-entity, pay-group and jurisdiction binding
effective lower bound, installer, approver and activation facts
signedPackLifecycle.onlyAllowedPeriodMutation: An open effectiveTo may be forward-closed once to a value greater than effectiveFrom; history is never shortened, deleted or rewritten.
signedPackLifecycle.providerBoundary: Module source may define typed verification and country-rule provider ports plus fail-closed production adapters and conformance doubles. A real trusted key set, real certified pack, statutory approval source or native calculation provider remains a separate production-binding authority.

idempotencyAndReceipt.requestDigest: SHA-256 over canonical schema version, packId, expected revision, exact normalized body and owner-resolved population scope; bearer, correlation and volatile transport metadata are excluded.
idempotencyAndReceipt.sameKeySameDigest: Return the original durable receipt without a second activation, audit or outbox effect.
idempotencyAndReceipt.transaction: Pack activation version, command receipt and audit outbox append commit atomically.
idempotencyAndReceipt.existingRunReceiptReuse: FORBIDDEN because pay_command_receipts requires run_id and its closed command/action guards accept payroll-run commands, not country-pack activation.

IAQ-026.itemIdentity: packId of the tenant-scoped installed-pack snapshot

IAQ-048.itemIdentity: the existing immutable workerResultId, used as the stable shared result-projection public ID for both PAY-003 social-insurance fields and future PAY-005 tax fields
IAQ-048.taxResultOwnership: TAX_RESULT belongs to BASE-TFR-PAY-005 and is omitted by PAY-003. Until that producer is admitted, otherwise valid worker-result rows use PARTIAL with one typed tax producer unavailable partialFailure; a future tax fact joins the same workerResultId and does not replace itemPublicId.
IAQ-048.availablePay003Action: hris.action.pay.country.pack.activate only when the exact item scope and preliminary PEP-PAY-028 decision allow it

sharedInvariants: COMPLETE EMPTY PARTIAL and UNAVAILABLE item cardinality
PARTIAL requires at least one exact partial failure
cursor binds tenant, legal-entity, pay-group, policy revision, asOf, filters, sorts, field decisions and freshness
stable itemPublicId tiebreak ordering and limit at most 100
field-decision summary exactly matches serialized VIEW MASK and omitted groups
deep links and actions are closed allowlists
trusted tenant and authority context are not serialized
locale and time zone are canonical
problem status, code and correlation are closed
entryQueries.noDoubleCounting: IAQ-026 never returns monetary outcome rows. IAQ-048 never treats configuration metadata as results and never derives TAX_RESULT or SOCIAL_INSURANCE from generic DEDUCTIONS.

calculationAndResultBoundary.forbiddenInference: Generic DEDUCTION lines or totals cannot be relabeled, split or copied as TAX_RESULT or SOCIAL_INSURANCE.
calculationAndResultBoundary.socialInsuranceFact: A typed country-rule provider outcome writes one immutable social-insurance result fact linked to the exact tenant, run, attempt and workerResultId plus its source result lines, country-pack snapshot, activation revision, policy version, amount, currency and canonical result digest. The fact is a field source for the stable worker-result projection item, not a new IAQ item identity.
calculationAndResultBoundary.socialInsuranceUniqueness: Exactly zero or one aggregated SOCIAL_INSURANCE fact exists for each tenantId and workerResultId. activationRevision and policyVersion are immutable lineage attributes, not uniqueness dimensions. The exact composite foreign key (tenant_id, run_id, attempt_no, worker_result_id) references V50 pay_worker_results, every source result line may contribute to at most one aggregate, and all amounts reconcile exactly.

migrationDecision.proof: The executed Payroll schema ends at V52; no production country-pack route, signed snapshot, scoped activation lifecycle, activation receipt, audit outbox or typed social-insurance result fact exists. The current foundation model stores only packId, version and digest references.
requiredControls: forced RLS and explicit same-tenant composite foreign keys
UUID public identities and no customer sequence leakage
append-only or narrowly forward-closing lifecycle guards
half-open effective periods and a single ever-activated winner per exact scope
signature and evidence digests with no legal formula or rate hardcoding
atomic activation receipt and audit-outbox persistence
PostedMoney NUMERIC(19,4) with canonical non-exponent wire strings and no implicit rounding
social-insurance fact lineage to generic immutable calculation output without changing V50 control-total semantics
forbidden: adding PAY_COUNTRY_PACK_ACTIVATE to the run-bound pay_command_receipts table
changing PayrollCalculated.v1 or its four control-total codes
hardcoding Korean legal rates, formulas, credentials or customer data

capabilityChanges: add PEP-PAY-028 hcm.operations.statutory.execute as ACTION.HRIS_STATUTORY_FILING:EXECUTE with PAYROLL_LEGAL_ENTITY_GROUP_SCOPE, HIGH step-up and PACK_INSTALLER_NE_STATUTORY_APPROVER
add IAQ-026 PAGE and DATA route contracts to hcm.configuration.workbench.view
add IAQ-048 PAGE and DATA route contracts to hcm.operations.payroll-support.view
add the country-pack activation ACTION route contract only to hcm.operations.statutory.execute
centralSuccessorRequirements.gatewayBoundary: Strip caller tenant and authority headers, require trusted legalEntityPublicId and payGroupPublicId owner-population evidence, inject exact STATUTORY_CONFIGURATION purpose and bind POST packId plus strong If-Match to the decision.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Feature defaults OFF with zero enrolled tenants; hidden pages make zero owner calls and direct URLs fail closed.
packId owner-resolves exactly one trusted tenant, LEGAL_ENTITY and PAY_GROUP scope; caller tenant or population authority is rejected.
The closed activation transport enforces canonical UUID, exact body, exact purpose, idempotency, strong If-Match and current HIGH step-up before mutation.
Signature, official reference, golden pack and statutory approval evidence all match the installed snapshot; missing real provider material fails closed.
Lifecycle, SoD, immutable lineage, monotonic retirement and nonoverlapping half-open effective periods are enforced in service and PostgreSQL.
Exact subject-and-action idempotency returns the original receipt for the same digest and 409 for a different digest with no duplicate effects.
Activation version, durable receipt and audit outbox append atomically; rollback, lost response and retry leave a deterministic recoverable outcome.
IAQ-026 returns only COUNTRY_PACK_METADATA, STATUTORY_RULE and ACTIVATION_STATUS with exact query-state, cursor, policy and field-decision invariants.

Social-insurance facts are immutable, PostedMoney-safe, unique per tenantId and stable workerResultId with an exact V50 composite foreign key, retain activation and policy as lineage attributes, and exactly reconcile their source lines; generic DEDUCTIONS are never reinterpreted.

IAQ-048 keeps workerResultId as itemPublicId, returns SOCIAL_INSURANCE and POLICY_VERSION only for PAY-003, and omits TAX_RESULT with a typed PARTIAL failure until PAY-005 can join the same stable item identity.
Both frontend workbenches render loading, empty, complete, partial, unavailable, forbidden and retry states accessibly and responsively; action exposure follows the exact owner PEP decision.
Fresh and V52-to-V53 PostgreSQL migration tests prove RLS, constraints, immutability, overlap, SoD, idempotency, atomicity and rollback without editing prior migrations.
Authorization-negative and tenant-isolation tests prove opaque cross-scope failure, stripped caller authority, exact purpose and current-policy re-evaluation.
Targeted recovery and telemetry tests cover provider unavailable, signature failure, stale CAS, duplicate request, audit publication retry and result unknown; no repository-wide suite is required.

nonClaims: Product authorization v54 or Auth V263 exists or is reserved.
Payroll V53 is reserved, active or authored.
An owner packet, worktree or executable token exists.
A real signing key, certified country pack, approval source or country-rule provider is bound.
TAX_RESULT is produced or BASE-TFR-PAY-005 is implemented.
The frontend route, shell or menu is mounted.
Any feature or tenant is activated or enrolled.
BASE-TFR-PAY-003 receives business-completion credit or is production complete.
